CONSTRUCTION_DEFINITION: Construction includes intermediate persisted candidate/source/evidence work within the future scoped grant; using a disposable directory does not exempt it. Promotion is added consequential repository-writing operation requiring separate authority.

ACTIVATION_PRECONDITIONS: effective charter and actual issuer/direct or delegated authority
explicit normative scope approval where required
sealed exact inputs, independent full expected outputs, protection and failure/retry rules
exact qualified executable/invocation/environment and actual resource/security permissions

EXACT_CHARTER_CLAUSES.FAIL_CLOSED: Stop on unknown scope, missing input/approval, mismatch, unqualified executable or failed comparison. No automatic retry or additional variant; retry only under its exact explicit bounded permission from approved immutable starting state.
EXACT_CHARTER_CLAUSES.POLICY: Explicit bounded qualification execution grant required; issuer must be owner under effective charter or exact delegate with this power. Charter effectiveness/normative approval is not an execution grant.

NORMATIVE_CLAUSES.FROZEN_ACCEPTANCE: No silent modification. Any proposed amendment must be separately identified/versioned with exact before/after clauses, assurance effects, owner approval and immutable preservation of original obligations/evidence; execution may not weaken or substitute its oracle to pass.
NORMATIVE_CLAUSES.POLICY: Prospective scenarios, normative rules, coverage boundaries and acceptance interpretations require explicit scoped approval. Technical design/verification is not adoption.

NO_CURRENT_PHASE_SPLIT_PERMISSION: No existing effective grant authorizes development or promotion. Exact prospective phase subjects require explicit owner approval and issuance/effectiveness; architectural agreement and static PASS are not authority.
PROSPECTIVE_POLICY_CHANGE_NOT_EFFECTIVE_: Changing120unissued allocations/counting or approving a new writable candidate root requires exact new scoped policy/operation approval, not silent reinterpretation. No amendment dossier manufactured without a specific binding clause needing change.
WHAT_WOULD_REQUIRE_AMENDMENT: Any changed effective frozen acceptance/earliest safety phase, actual115producer/byte rule, old one-use/zero-retry scope, protected-history obligation or actual mandatory control weakening.
